- Hosting: GitHub Pages + custom domain (not Cloudflare Worker/rewrite)
- Submodule holds the static site source, synced from the existing skill file
- All existing references get replaced, not duplicated long-term

# Keep the create.pantoken.app static site (a separate GitHub repo, checked out here as the

# changes on main. See docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md for the manual equivalent and the

# the default GITHUB_TOKEN can't push to a different repo. If the secret isn't set, this job skips
# the push (and warns) instead of failing, so it's safe to merge before the secret is configured.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/**"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code (with submodules)
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: true

      - name: Check for publish token
        id: check-token
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.CREATE_PANTOKEN_APP_PAT }}" ]; then
            echo "configured=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::warning::CREATE_PANTOKEN_APP_PAT secret is not set; skipping create.pantoken.app publish. See docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md."
          else
            echo "configured=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      # Plain `node` script (no external deps), so no vp/pnpm setup needed.
      - name: Stage the skill into the submodule
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.configured == 'true'
        run: node docs/scripts/stage-create-pantoken-app-domain.ts

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.configured == 'true'
        working-directory: ai/create-pantoken-app-site
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.CREATE_PANTOKEN_APP_PAT }}@github.com/thedannywahl/create-pantoken-app.git"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Commit submodule pointer bump
